text_block_list.text:
Though she had delivered magnificent results,
……she somehow seemed downcast.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya ran all the way through, didn't she?
So praise me, praise me~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Haaah... Maya loves getting praised by Trainer-chan~.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. You can keep patting my head
a little bit longer, you know~?

...It seemed Mayano Top Gun's
mood had improved a little.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Never mind that kind of stuff right now!
Praise me properly! Tell me 'good job'!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: "I'm not moving a single step from here until you satisfy me, Trainer-chan!"
"...I ended up having to keep soothing Mayano Top Gun as she threw a tantrum like that."
